flows.name: Measure Selected Tooth
flows.description: With teeth and pulp volumes, metadata, and a tooth label present, measure_canal isolates both masks by the parsed FDI label, invokes canal_measurement_module_v2, and then builds the returned canal plot, table rows, and status message.

annotations.text: This flow represents the successful path after both input guards pass and canal_measurement_module_v2 returns. Internal single-canal, multi-canal, anterior, and posterior choices do not change the two modeled collaborations.

The path is entered only when teeth_instance, pulps_instance, metadata, and tooth_label are present. Its outcome is a canal plot, one table row per returned canal, and a status naming the selected FDI tooth.

codeLinks.description: Checks required inputs, parses the selected FDI label, invokes measurement, and builds the plot, rows, and status.
Calculates and returns the canal results and restored-presentation inputs consumed by measure_canal.

steps.label: Measure the canals for the selected tooth.
Build the table rows, spatial view, and completion status from the returned results.

flows.name: Request Tooth Selection
flows.description: With teeth and pulp volumes and metadata loaded but no tooth label selected, measure_canal stops before mask isolation or measurement and asks the researcher to select a tooth.

annotations.text: After the loaded-data guard passes, a missing or empty tooth_label returns no plot, an empty row list, and the message “Select a tooth from the dropdown.”
canal_measurement_module_v2 is not invoked on this path because the tooth-selection guard returns first.

codeLinks.description: Returns the empty presentation and tooth-selection guidance before parsing an FDI label or invoking measurement.

steps.label: Return an empty plot and table with guidance to select a tooth.
